cargo_build_phase:
runHook preBuild
cargo --version
cargoBuildLog=$(mktemp cargoBuildLogXXXX.json)
cargo build --release --message-format json-render-diagnostics --locked -p linnest -p kurvst --features linnest/typst-plugin,kurvst/typst-plugin --target wasm32-unknown-unknown  >"$cargoBuildLog"

runHook postBuild
reproduction_scope: Independent Nix final producer rebuild matched both complete WASM/bundle outputs. Source-qualified dependency artifacts were reused normally. This is not a cold-dependency reproducibility proof, nor a retroactive repair/certification of historical Linnest data/name differences.
